items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: Thomas C's joint. Thomas C was at our end.

ctx.x: I played there with that, what was that place on the highway, on Clavin Avenue up there? Remember that place? What the hell they called? We used to put some Jacks programs on up there. How far up was it? Not too far, it was past where, it was past the roadways. Oh, up in Jefferson. Yeah, yeah, up in Jefferson. Thomas C's joint. Thomas C was at our end.
Thomas C was over across the river. Huh? Evans Thomas C was across the river.
Now wait a minute, he was on this side.
